name: The Clarity Session
who: One decision, one situation, worked through properly in a single sitting.
length: One 90 minute session and a 30 minute follow-up
includes: A short written brief from you beforehand
A written summary with the decision, options and next steps
A 30 minute follow-up call three weeks later
note: The fee is credited against The Next Move or The Leadership Engagement if you continue within 30 days.
heroFact: The fee is credited against The Next Move or The Leadership Engagement within 30 days.
secondary: Not sure? Start with a free conversation

name: The Next Move
who: For people making a specific career move: stepping up into management, landing the next role, or starting well in a new one.
length: Six 60 minute sessions over twelve weeks
payment: Payable when you book. One payment, or two of €600.
includes: A transition map of your situation, built in the first session
A written 90 day plan you leave with
bookingNote: Starts with a 45 minute first conversation.

name: The Leadership Engagement
who: For experienced managers and senior leaders growing into a bigger role or leading through change.
length: Eight 90 minute sessions over six months
payment: Payable when you book. One payment, or three of €1,000.
includes: Structured 360 feedback gathered at the start from your manager, peers and team
bookingNote: Starts with a 45 minute first conversation.

name: Ongoing Partnership
who: For people who want a standing thinking partner, or who want to start with a session or two before committing to a programme.
length: 60 minute sessions, booked singly or in blocks
payment: Payable when you book, singly or as a block.
includes: 60 minute sessions, booked singly or in blocks
A block of four for €720, saving 10%, or eight for €1,360, saving 15%
Blocks are valid for six months and include messaging between sessions and priority scheduling
note: Six single sessions cost the same as The Next Move, which also includes the transition map, workbook and written plan.
bookingNote: Books one session. Blocks start with the first conversation.
